# Generated documentation

**Do not edit anything in this directory by hand.** These files are produced from source by CI.

| File | Generated from |
| --- | --- |
| `api-reference.*` | OpenAPI spec, route decorators, or handler definitions |
| `db-schema.*` | ORM schema and migrations |

A hand-edited file here will be overwritten, and worse, will be trusted while it is wrong. If
generation is not wired up yet, record that in `docs/known-issues.md` rather than writing these
by hand.
